## Summary
- surface global tree-sitter import/init degradation in both prescan artifact formats
- emit per-file degraded metadata only when tree-sitter is globally unavailable
- add focused regression coverage and a rebased task packet/proof

## Validation
- packet and embedded-audit schemas pass
- focused prescan tests and offline golden smoke pass
- compileall, pre-commit, and diff check pass

## Audit status
- SKIPPED: PAL MCP transport closed for analyze, planner, challenge, codereview, and precommit; the proof records this fail-closed audit gap.
- no live provider calls or extraction runs were performed.

## Known worktree state
- .claude/claude_config.json is an auto-generated per-worktree identity change and is not included in this PR.
